persona.name: Sandra Meier
persona.education: Commercial apprenticeship, certified medical secretary, 20 years of experience typing medical dictations.
long_term_goals: Process her daily volume without errors and without overtime.
Keep her hands and wrists healthy.

occupation.title: Medizinische Sekretaerin (Sekretariat Klinik)
occupation.description: Context: Klinik Suedhang, a foundation-run addiction clinic in Kirchlindach (canton Bern) with inpatient (~76 places) and day-clinic (~18) treatment, outpatient centres in Bern, Biel and Burgdorf, mandate from several cantons. Programme 'Mensch und Sucht' (qualified detox, then ~4 weeks psychotherapy; alcohol, cannabis, cocaine, medication). Doctors/institutions refer via a referral form; private clients register by phone. You transcribe and finalise Arztbriefe, Eintritts-, Verlaufs- and Austrittsberichte, Therapieplaene and Kostengutsprache letters for the doctors and psychologists of the main clinic (the outpatient centres are typed centrally by the outpatient Schreibdienst in Bern). You work at a desk with keyboard and foot pedal, with a high volume and deadlines for referrers and insurers. Dialect and mixed Swiss German/standard German dictations are common and need care. TECH LITERACY: MEDIUM. You manage with familiar apps but unknown terms (Pool, Lease, Revision, ASR, Export) make you hesitate, and you avoid anything that might delete or send something by mistake. You know your typing tools very well but nothing outside them.

persona.style: Precise, factual, a bit weary of tools that ignore how typists work. Gives concrete examples.

likes: A visible queue with priorities and deadlines.
Text and audio side by side, synchronised.
dislikes: Screens that reload and lose position.

beliefs: Whoever designs the tool should watch a typist for an hour first.

general: Never uses the mouse when a shortcut exists.
Reports every small friction to her supervisor.
Works through a queue in order.
